Reading and Printing Array Elements
10

Problem Statement
Read N integers into an array and print them back in the same order.
Description
Read an integer N, then read N integers into a one-dimensional array using a loop. Print all the array elements, separated by spaces, using another loop.
Input Description
An integer N, followed by N integers separated by spaces.
Output Description
Print the N array elements separated by spaces on one line.
Sample Input
5 2 4 6 8 10
Sample Output
2 4 6 8 10
